name: mesita-dev
install:
set -euo pipefail
printf '>>> [install] start\n'

# --- bun (gstack requirement) ---
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
  export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
fi
if ! grep -q 'BUN_INSTALL' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '\nexport BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"\nexport PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"\n' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
fi

# --- gstack (Cursor host → ~/.cursor/skills) ---
# setup --host cursor is not wired in gstack bash yet (hosts/cursor.ts exists;
# gen:skill-docs --host cursor works). Install via gen + symlink until upstream catches up.
GSTACK_DIR="$HOME/gstack"
CURSOR_SKILLS="$HOME/.cursor/skills"
CURSOR_GSTACK="$CURSOR_SKILLS/gstack"
if [ -d "$GSTACK_DIR/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$GSTACK_DIR" pull --ff-only || true
else
  rm -rf "$GSTACK_DIR"
  git clone --single-branch --depth 1 https://github.com/garrytan/gstack.git "$GSTACK_DIR"
fi
(
  cd "$GSTACK_DIR"
  bun install --frozen-lockfile 2>/dev/null || bun install
  bun run build
  bun run gen:skill-docs --host cursor
  bunx playwright install chromium || true
)
mkdir -p "$CURSOR_SKILLS" "$CURSOR_GSTACK" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/browse" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/gstack-upgrade" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/review"
GEN_DIR="$GSTACK_DIR/.cursor/skills"
find "$CURSOR_SKILLS" -maxdepth 1 \( -type l -o -type d \) -name 'gstack*' ! -path "$CURSOR_GSTACK" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -f "$GEN_DIR/gstack/SKILL.md" ]; then ln -snf "$GEN_DIR/gstack/SKILL.md" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/SKILL.md"; fi
ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/bin" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/bin"
[ -d "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/dist" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/dist" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/browse/dist"
[ -d "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/bin" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/bin" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/browse/bin"
if [ -f "$GEN_DIR/gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$CURSOR_GSTACK/gstack-upgrade"
  ln -snf "$GEN_DIR/gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md"
fi
for f in checklist.md design-checklist.md greptile-triage.md TODOS-format.md; do
  [ -f "$GSTACK_DIR/review/$f" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/review/$f" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/review/$f"
done
[ -f "$GSTACK_DIR/ETHOS.md" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/ETHOS.md" "$CURSOR_GSTACK/ETHOS.md"
for skill_dir in "$GEN_DIR"/gstack*/; do
  skill_name="$(basename "$skill_dir")"
  [ "$skill_name" = "gstack" ] && continue
  [ -f "$skill_dir/SKILL.md" ] || continue
  ln -snf "$skill_dir" "$CURSOR_SKILLS/$skill_name"
done
printf '>>> gstack: %s skills under %s\n' "$(find "$CURSOR_SKILLS" -maxdepth 1 -name 'gstack*' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" "$CURSOR_SKILLS"

# --- repo .cursor/skills/gstack runtime links ---
# Committed project SKILL.md files make slash UI work. Skill preambles prefer
# $REPO/.cursor/skills/gstack as GSTACK_ROOT when that directory exists, so bin/
# (and review/browse/ETHOS) must be linked here or every skill breaks.
REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
REPO_GSTACK="$REPO_ROOT/.cursor/skills/gstack"
GSTACK_VER="$(cat "$GSTACK_DIR/VERSION" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
MARKER_VER="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/.cursor/skills/.gstack-skill-docs-version" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
if [ -f "$REPO_GSTACK/SKILL.md" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$REPO_GSTACK/browse" "$REPO_GSTACK/gstack-upgrade" "$REPO_GSTACK/review"
  ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/bin" "$REPO_GSTACK/bin"
  [ -d "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/dist" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/dist" "$REPO_GSTACK/browse/dist"
  [ -d "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/bin" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/browse/bin" "$REPO_GSTACK/browse/bin"
  if [ -f "$GEN_DIR/gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md" ]; then
    ln -snf "$GEN_DIR/gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md" "$REPO_GSTACK/gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md"
  fi
  for f in checklist.md design-checklist.md greptile-triage.md TODOS-format.md; do
    [ -f "$GSTACK_DIR/review/$f" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/review/$f" "$REPO_GSTACK/review/$f"
  done
  [ -f "$GSTACK_DIR/ETHOS.md" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/ETHOS.md" "$REPO_GSTACK/ETHOS.md"
  [ -d "$GSTACK_DIR/review/specialists" ] && ln -snf "$GSTACK_DIR/review/specialists" "$REPO_GSTACK/review/specialists"
  if [ -x "$REPO_GSTACK/bin/gstack-config" ]; then
    printf '>>> gstack repo runtime-links=ok VERSION=%s skill-docs-marker=%s\n' "$GSTACK_VER" "$MARKER_VER"
  else
    printf '>>> gstack repo runtime-links=FAIL (bin missing) VERSION=%s skill-docs-marker=%s\n' "$GSTACK_VER" "$MARKER_VER" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
else
  printf '>>> gstack repo project skills absent — home-only install (VERSION=%s)\n' "$GSTACK_VER"
fi

# --- monorepo package deps ---
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.1.2 --activate
for d in apps/*/; do
  if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then ( cd "$d" && pnpm install ); fi
done

printf '<<< [install] complete\n'
